svg.text: What do you actually do as Plant manager?
Line lead → Plant manager: you leave the floor. Each line now has a foreman, one of your robots, promoted, who writes their crew’s instructions.
A real plant manager doesn’t tell lines how to work. They control what no single line controls. That only matters if lines share things.
who works on which line, hiring, who’s foreman
the budget split; approving a line’s request
which line takes which order, what comes first
the supply belt, the floaters, the dock
During shifts: answer foremen at your desk.
A question you answer twice should become
a policy, so your desk gets quieter.
Floaters (belong to the plant, not a line)
Paint is at 90%. Fixit is on
Line A. Wait 20 s, or pull
Behind on blue. Can I borrow
Dot for the rest of the shift?
1. Service any machine past 80%. Fixit goes to the most worn one first.
3. Don’t take Line A’s robots without asking me.
Every line has its own belt, fixer and budget.
Each line is the Line lead game with a foreman playing it.
All you can say is “meet your quota”. Nothing to decide.
Lines compete for the belt, the floaters and the budget.
Foremen hit conflicts they can’t settle alone, so they come to you.
That’s the job: deciding who gets what.
